integrity: All claims rely on the written proof and the stated published binary invariant. Exact finite checks are corroborative, not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Index K(r,m) is an explicit existence bound using a prime in an arithmetic progression, not a claim of least possible onset.
The integer-state congruence requires odd m; it does not assert 2-adic stabilization.
No independent priority assessment has been conducted; an unindexed general modular wheel-polynomial theorem could subsume the lemma.
title: Eventual modular annihilation of primorial wheels and their prime-recurrence states
